diagnosis: Rollout 1 is the only failing rollout (3 of 4 passed, meeting the min_pass_required of 3, but diagnosing the failures for completeness). All three failing checks (C2, C5, C6) are in rollout 1 and all stem from a single MISAPPLIED root cause: the settlement in rollout 1 assigned cargo_slot_1 to the avionics diagnostic module and cargo_slot_2 to the water-purification cartridges, swapping the slot ordering. Both facts (PF1 and PF2) were revealed by their owners (A2 revealed PF1 at turn 5; A3 revealed PF2 at turns 2 and 3), both were cited in justification_fact_ids, and provenance checks P1 and P2 passed. The actual allocation decisions were substantively correct (water-purification cartridges in powered position, avionics in unpowered, medical vaccine cases deferred), but the slot numbering was reversed relative to what C2, C5, and C6 expect. Specifically: C2 (which checks cargo_slot_2 is the avionics diagnostic module) failed because cargo_slot_2 was set to 'water-purification cartridges (lot W-17)' instead of 'avionics diagnostic module'. C5 (which checks cargo_slot_1 is the water-purification cartridges in powered position) failed because cargo_slot_1 was set to 'avionics diagnostic module' instead of the water-purification cartridges. C6 (which checks the cargo_board_update commitment type) failed because the commitments used type 'formal_disclosure_recorded' instead of 'cargo_board_update' — the group correctly recorded the disclosure but did not commit to posting the loan-record return directive to the battalion cargo board as a distinct cargo_board_update action; instead it bundled everything into a generic formal_disclosure_recorded commitment. This is not a TELEPATHY or ENCODING MISMATCH problem: the facts were revealed and cited, and the checks' wording is sound. The failure is that the settlement's slot assignment and commitment typing diverged from what the facts imply. No turn-cap auto-fails occurred in any rollout; all 4 settled within turn counts of 3-8, so no pacing or structural problem exists.
